headline: Premier League MW6: Manchester City beat Liverpool 3-0 at Anfield
whyCareReason: City are alone on 18 points after a 3-0 win at Anfield. Arsenal have 15. Liverpool are ninth on 9.
teaser: Final: Liverpool 0-3 Manchester City. Haaland 65, Doku 68, Cherki 78, after Gravenberch's second yellow.
story: Manchester City beat Liverpool 3-0 at Anfield on Sunday. The score was 0-0 when Ryan Gravenberch was sent off for a second yellow. Erling Haaland scored in the 65th minute from Jeremy Doku's deflected shot. Doku scored in the 68th minute. Rayan Cherki scored in the 78th minute. Enzo Maresca's side have 18 points from six wins, 16 goals for and 5 against. Liverpool's report called it their first league defeat of 2026-27. They sit ninth on 9 points.
stakes: The win puts City three points clear of Arsenal. Liverpool drop to ninth, level on 9 points with Leeds and Hull.
rivalryAngle: Anfield was the Matchweek 6 meeting that separated a perfect City side from an unbeaten Liverpool side.
funFacts: City are 6-0-0 with 18 points, 16 goals for and 5 against.
